as_told.title: New Year's Eve seance of nine elites with Puharich

related.note: Both describe the first channeling of the Nine at Puharich's group in Maine in 1952. This telling puts it at Dr. Vinod's unexpected trance on his first night, while the story puts it at a séance of nine people on New Year's Eve 1952-53.

plain: A seance with nine people was held in Maine around New Year's Eve 1952 to 1953, and it is said to have opened contact with a group of beings called the Nine. The author Peter Levenda tells this without naming a source, linking it to the researcher Andrija Puharich and to the inventor Arthur Young and his wife Ruth Forbes Paine Young. In a later episode Michels repeats it, citing Levenda, and adds that the nine people at the table were members of the elite, which would mean powerful figures were involved in early channelled contact.
